pkgmetadata.longdescription: Crispy is a free, offline-first desktop application providing AI-powered noise suppression, speech transcription, and meeting recording. Runs entirely locally using whisper.cpp and ONNX Runtime models, with no cloud dependency. Built with Tauri 2, React, and Rust.

use.flag: Enable speaker diarization (who-spoke-when) via in-tree ONNX segmentation and NME-SC spectral clustering
